name: Michelada
description: Beer with lime, salt and hot sauce over ice in a chilli-rimmed glass.

tcm.note: Read with beer, which TCM reads as cold.

ayurveda.note: Madya and chilli are both ushna.

histamine.note: Beer plus lime plus hot sauce — every mechanism at once.

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. Built on a full beer, it delivers exactly what beer alone does — the lime and hot sauce don't change the alcohol. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
